articles.summary: Highlights of Ameris’s results for the third quarter of 2026 include the following: Net income of $116.1 million, or $1.73 per diluted share Return on average assets of 1.61% Return on average tangible common equity (1) of 15.01% Efficiency ratio of 49.32% Growth in average earning assets of $300.5 million, or 4.5% annualized Loan growth of $173.1 million, or 3.1% annualized Deposit growth of $319.4 million, or 5.6% annualized Noninterest-bearing deposits represent 29.2% of total deposits Annualized net charge-offs declined to 0.19% of average total loans Tangible book value (1) growth of $0.55 per share, or 4.8% annualized, to $45.65 at September 30, 2026 Ameris Bancorp (NYSE: ABCB) (the “Company” or “Ameris”) today reported net income of $116.1 million, or $1.73 per diluted share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared with $106.0 million, or $1.54 per diluted share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. articles.summary: Ameris Bancorp (NYSE: ABCB) (the “Company”) announced today that it intends to release its third quarter 2026 financial results in a press release after the market closes on Thursday, October 22, 2026. H. Palmer Proctor, Jr., Chief Executive Officer, Nicole S. Stokes, Chief Financial Officer, and Douglas D. Strange, Chief Credit Officer, will host a teleconference at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time on Friday, October 23, 2026 to discuss the Company's results and answer appropriate questions. The conference call can be accessed by dialing 1-844-481-2939. The conference call ID is Ameris Bancorp. A replay of the call will be available beginning one hour after the end of the conference call until October 30, 2026. To listen to the replay, dial 1-855-669-9658. The conference replay access code is 7791097. The financial information discussed will be available on the Investor Relations page of the Ameris Bank website at ir.amerisbank.com .
